description_short: The NIG International Symposium on the Future of Biocuration, AI, and Knowledge takes place at Mishima City Cultural Hall, Japan, from 7 to 11 June 2027. Oral and poster abstracts (up to 4 pages) and workshop proposals are submitted via EasyChair by 31 January 2027.
status_evidence: Organisers' call for papers on EasyChair (seen in search results) lists abstract registration and submission deadlines of January 31, 2027 for the symposium at Mishima City Cultural Hall, June 7-11, 2027
Deadline is in the future relative to the run date 2026-11-20
Status capped at OPEN_LIKELY: official page not loadable from this environment and the submission system was not independently confirmed
uncertainties: Evidence seen through web-search results of the official page; the page itself could not be fetched from this environment

Approved source lists were unreachable from this environment; found by web search and confirmed on official pages, so source_list_url is the closest approved category rather than the page it was listed on
Evidence comes from the organisers' EasyChair call for papers; the symposium's own website (linked from the CFP) was not seen in the results

Organising committee listed as Masanori Arita, Susumu Goto and Yasunori Yamamoto of the National Institute of Genetics; an NIG committee record (April 2026) shows the symposium approved for fiscal 2027
Only the date string is quoted; time zone of the deadline not stated
Registration fees and any support not recorded
